Aspect of the Huntress
5% of base mana
Instant cast10 sec cooldown
Melee and ranged auto attacks now have a 30% chance to drain the target's mana equal to 25% of the damage dealt and apply Scattered Stars, but your damage is reduced by 25% while this is active.
